assets.description: Patient medical records containing medical histories and test results
Clinic servers hosting the patient records system
External IT provider remote access to the clinic servers

vulnerabilities.description: Staff accounts may rely only on username and password without multi-factor authentication
Access permissions may not adequately restrict patient records according to staff roles
The public appointment-booking website may not adequately validate user input
The external provider's remote access may be insufficiently restricted or monitored
Clinic servers may not be patched promptly because maintenance is outsourced

threats.description: An external attacker compromises a staff account to access patient records
A malicious or careless staff member accesses or modifies patient records without authorisation
An external attacker exploits the public booking website to access or disrupt appointment data
An attacker compromises the external provider's remote access to gain control of the clinic servers
Ransomware encrypts the clinic servers and makes patient records unavailable
